question: does the HF-1 frame compensation (q clk at region root, every other region sink on one shared trunk 445 TT / 355.5 FF, C 530/423) hold q<->neighbour FF hold and TT setup in frame STA

frames.l4: col_h9_l4 / col_h10_l4 give byte-identical extracted q-region netlists and SPEF (only the cfifo differs) -> covered by col_h9 / col_h10

etm_clock_insertion: All four ETMs come from OpenSTA write_timing_model on the routed propagated-clock child: arcs FOLD the child's own insertion (q FF clk->pval[12] 474 ps = ~348 tree + ~126; setup/hold arcs carry it, e.g. q go hold +369 FF) and the min/max_clock_tree_path entries record it. So the frame adds only the frame-level latency. NOTE: run the frame STA with PROPAGATED clocks: with an ideal clock OpenSTA strips each macro's clock_tree_path from its launch arcs and capture checks (ideal = zero insertion), which made a first ideal-mode run report a false -186 ps FF hold (q_to_qbankN launch 126 instead of 474); that run is superseded, not a result.

method.netlist: fsta_build.py: flat structural netlist from the frame RTL keeping the 12 q + 12 qbank_S + 12 qbank_N + 12 cfg7_seq instances as ETM cells with the frame's real pin-to-pin nets (9492 child->child sinks, all within the slot); nets touching other frame cells or frame ports cut to unconstrained ports; the frame clk net split into clk_q (q clock pins) and clk_n (neighbour clock pins)
method.clock: create_clock 833 ps on {clk_q clk_n}, propagated; set_clock_latency -source 0 clk_q, TRUNK clk_n; uncertainty 60 setup / 25 hold; setup judged at TT, hold at FF (owner option B)
method.wire: w1 = star RC per net from the frame floorplan (c26l cluster boxes + LEF pin positions, Manhattan, unbuffered, ORFS asap7 signal RC 0.0265684 kohm/um, 0.16579 fF/um; nets 8-164 um: qbank_S->q 8-9, q->qbank_N 58-101, q<->cfg7_seq 113-164); w0 = zero wire (hold bound)
method.unconstrained_sinks: 240 per frame: qbank_S.o_cfg -> q.cfg_d (216) and o_x0 -> q.xs_sv (24) land on q pins with capacitance 0 and no arcs in the q ETM (unloaded inside q), so no check exists
method.tool: OpenSTA (openroad/orfs:asap7lock sta) via ot-run on ot-epyc5, run_fsta.sh; aggregation fsta_report.py; per-run logs logs/*.log, per-pin-group detail runs.json

col_h10: identical numbers to col_h9 in every run (same slot geometry and wiring pattern)

summary.worst_hold_FF: +99.6 ps (q.pval/prow -> qbank_N, zero wire; +125.8 with wire); +81.8 ps with the trunk 5% late at FF
summary.worst_setup_TT_q_pairs: cfg7_seq->q +355.2, q->qbank_N +379.1, q->cfg7_seq +384.2, qbank_S->q +400.6 (wire); worst overall +342.3 (cfg7_seq->qbank_S, both on the trunk)
summary.fix_needed: none: no hold pad, trunk change or q-pin landing needed. Margin absorbs ~80 ps extra FF q->qbank_N skew beyond the 25 ps uncertainty.

not_covered: frame-internal clock-tree skew between slots beyond the +-5% trunk sensitivity (covered by the uncertainty + >=80 ps margin); repeaters on 100-164 um nets (unbuffered RC used, pessimistic for setup); SS corner (owner sign-off is TT setup / FF hold)
